#### README.md
```
# lilical

A multi-backend calendar for the Linux desktop.

Read AND write across **Google Calendar**, **Outlook/Microsoft 365**, and **CalDAV** in one app, with a dense Business-Calendar-inspired UI.

## Quick start

```bash
pixi install
pixi run migrate
pixi run run
```

## Development

```bash
pixi run test     # run tests
pixi run lint     # ruff check
pixi run fmt      # ruff format
pixi run typecheck  # basedpyright
```

## Releases

To cut a release: `git tag v0.2.0 && git push origin v0.2.0`. CI builds the
AppImage and publishes it to GitHub Releases automatically. The
`OAUTH_CREDENTIALS_JSON` repo secret must be set; without it the Google backend
in the released AppImage will be non-functional.

For a test run before tagging for real, push a pre-release tag
(`v0.0.0-test`) — `workflow_dispatch` in the Actions UI also works and
uploads the artifact without creating a release.

## License

GPL-3.0-or-later

```

#### pyproject.toml
```
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=68", "setuptools-scm>=8"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "lilical"
dynamic = ["version"]
description = "Linux calendar app — Google, Outlook, CalDAV"
license = { text = "GPL-3.0-or-later" }
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"

[project.scripts]
lilical = "lilical.app:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
lilical = ["ui/styles/*.qss", "ui/styles/*.svg"]

[tool.setuptools_scm]
version_file = "src/lilical/_version.py"
fallback_version = "0.0.0+unknown"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 88
target-version = "py312"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "N", "W", "ASYNC", "B", "SIM"]

[tool.ruff.lint.pep8-naming]
extend-ignore-names = [
    "acceptNavigationRequest",
    "addItem",
    "expandingDirections",
    "hasHeightForWidth",
    "heightForWidth",
    "itemAt",
    "keyPressEvent",
    "minimumSize",
    "setGeometry",
    "sizeHint",
    "takeAt",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
asyncio_mode = "auto"

[tool.basedpyright]
include = ["src", "tests"]
typeCheckingMode = "strict"
reportUnknownMemberType = false
reportUnknownVariableType = false
reportUnknownParameterType = false
reportUnknownArgumentType = false
reportMissingParameterType = false
reportUnknownLambdaType = false
reportMissingImports = false
reportMissingModuleSource = false
reportMissingTypeStubs = false
reportAny = false
reportUntypedBaseClass = false
reportPrivateUsage = false
reportGeneralTypeIssues = false
reportMissingTypeArgument = false
reportAttributeAccessIssue = false

[[tool.basedpyright.executionEnvironments]]
root = "tests"
reportUntypedFunctionDecorator = false
reportUnusedFunction = false

```
